description: The Fleaflicker league's strategy (Settings/leagues/beagles.json): strategy.json with the live choices: adddrop.tail = 'cost' (a swap must also cover the rest-of-season value it loses; seat-paired on 2024-25 neutral, +0.21 +/- 0.40 pts/wk pooled) and streaming.mode = 'week' (Decisions/weekplan.py; +2.01 +/- 0.62 pts/wk, 2024-25, 16 drafts); and streaming.gate = true with streaming.next_week = 1.0 -- on the week's last day with the week won (P(win) >= 0.9), a pickup is priced on next week alone. The user's call for a league that streams heavily (2026-09-27): in the 2024-25 backtest it cost -1.45 +/- 0.62 pts/wk (win rate +0.007 +/- 0.013, 8 drafts); the backtest's leaguemates may not stream like this league's. Every other value equals strategy.json (verify.py 'live strategy').
